description.en: The ID of the ApsaraMQ for MQTT client that you want to query.

description.zh: 云消息队列 MQTT 版实例的ID，一定要和客户端实际使用的实例ID匹配。您可以在[控制台](https://mqtt.console.aliyun.com)**实例详情**页面获取该ID。
description.en: The ID of the ApsaraMQ for MQTT instance. The ID must be consistent with the ID of the instance that the ApsaraMQ for MQTT client uses. You can obtain the instance ID on the **Instance Details** page that corresponds to the instance in the [ApsaraMQ for MQTT console](https://mqtt.console.aliyun.com).

descriptions.zh:
- **QuerySessionByClientId**接口的QPS限制为500。更多信息请参见[QPS限制](~~163047~~)。
- 每成功调用一次**QuerySessionByClientId**接口，都会计算为一次消息TPS，从而影响您的计费。详情请参见[计费说明](~~52819~~)。
descriptions.en:
- You can call this operation up to 500 times per second.\*\*\*\* For more information, see [Limits on QPS](~~163047~~).

- Each successful call to the **QuerySessionByClientId** operation increases the messaging transactions per second (TPS) by one. This affects the billing of your instance. For more information, see [Billing rules](~~52819~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun onsmqtt query-session-by-client-id --client-id GID_test@@@test --instance-id post-cn-0pp12gl0000 --api-version 2020-04-20 --region cn-hangzhou
